screens.name: Home — settled, transition and omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 establishes orb dominance and disclosed omen unavailability, while supplied browser checks support enlarged layout and reduced motion.
findings: Keep the whisper and orb vertically stable through entry so the transition and settled compositions feel continuous.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent compositions, and runtime evidence reports automatic advancement after 650ms or immediately with reduced motion.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement preserves understandable focus and announcements with a physical screen reader.

screens.name: Ask — normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled question field, explicit voice alternative and prominent submission button, supported by reported browser form traversal.
findings: Replace the technical phrase 'prediction engine' with a plain explanation of where submitted information goes.

screens.name: Ask — large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows legible enlarged input and stacked actions with no visible horizontal clipping.
findings: Verify that the enlarged question and submission remain reachable with the actual phone keyboard open.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show typing promoted above retry and a persistent microphone failure notice, with transcription preservation reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Place the failure explanation closer to the typing and retry controls to reduce the distance between cause and recovery.

screens.name: Planning — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a named processing stage, duration expectation, credit reassurance and Cancel, with reduced-motion behavior reported as checked.
findings: Verify that the stage and eventual completion are announced without repeatedly announcing the decorative loading content.

screens.name: Question 1 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows four separated choices and numeric progress, while runtime evidence reports immediate advancement after selection.
findings: Align every response with the same question axis, since 'Barely started' describes progress while 'Nearly certain' describes confidence.

screens.name: Question 2 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show consistent option spacing and progress from one to two, but no persisted selected-answer state.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement announces the new question and that returning clearly identifies the previous answer.

screens.name: Question 3 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves the question layout and shows three of three, with follow-up completion supported by reported browser traversal.
findings: Make the final answer's transition into prediction processing explicit for screen-reader users.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows question context, a labeled multiline field, Change and disabled Continue, while runtime evidence reports retained text.
findings: Rename 'Change' to 'Choose an answer' so returning to preset choices is unambiguous.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the full enlarged question, field and disabled submission without relying on the decorative orb.
findings: Keep a short visible instruction explaining that entering an answer enables Continue.

screens.name: Custom answer — filled, large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows retained multiline content and a fully visible enlarged reveal button, supported by the supplied large-form checks.
findings: Verify longer answers and caret movement on a physical phone without losing access to submission.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard-constrained viewport
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the filled field and submission in constrained space, while runtime evidence explicitly limits this to a synthetic viewport.
findings: Test the actual keyboard, safe areas and scrolling because this crop cannot demonstrate retained question context on a device.

screens.name: Research — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 differentiates research from planning through stage copy while retaining duration, credit and cancellation guidance.
findings: Verify an accessible stage-change announcement so the visually similar loading screens communicate progress without motion.

screens.name: Plan error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show distinct retry and edit actions with no-charge reassurance, and supplied runtime evidence reports connection recovery.
findings: Verify repeated retry failure preserves the original question and returns focus to the error explanation.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the retry and edit recovery paths without presenting the failure as a completed reading.
findings: Verify all answers survive repeated retries and navigation through Review answers.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning redirect and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a support route, alternate-question actions and no-storage reassurance, with a real sensitive redirect reported in the browser drive.
findings: Give the support route at least equal visual prominence to starting another entertainment reading.

screens.name: Sensitive question — prediction redirect and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 retains the same recovery hierarchy after prediction processing and explicitly states that no reading was spent.
findings: Verify that the support destination works on-device and that returning preserves an understandable recovery state.

screens.name: Reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a prominent forecast, uncertainty label and recovery actions, but the transition capture renders the forecast substantially dimmer.
findings: Keep forecast text readable throughout its entrance because the supplied contrast checks exclude partly opaque text.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded Why and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a clearly expanded explanation with a collapse control, while the long fixture body continues beyond the viewport.
findings: Structure long explanations into short labeled sections and verify that expansion preserves focus and access to remaining actions.

screens.name: Check-in — outcome prompt and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places three outcome choices beside the saved result, and supplied runtime evidence reports outcome persistence without showing its selected state here.
findings: Show a persistent checked outcome and a saved confirmation after recording the response.

screens.name: History — empty and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a concise empty-state explanation, an Ask action and explicit device-local storage wording.
findings: Verify that the text-only Ask action has a full accessible touch target.

screens.name: History — populated and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 distinguish the original question, forecast, date and Waiting status, with persistence reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Clarify what 'Waiting' means by associating it with the next check-in date.

screens.name: History — populated stress state
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows consistent repeated rows and a partially visible next item above navigation, supported by reported scroll-clearance checks.
findings: Verify that the final row and its controls can scroll completely above the raised Ask orb at 200% text.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples, selected question and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 explicitly labels offline samples and uses a checkmark for Love, while the primary action sits partly outside the visible content area.
findings: Reduce vertical spacing enough to expose the complete Ask this too action on initial entry.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 discloses offline status, limits sharing scope and shows disabled creation, which the supplied controls evidence confirms.
findings: Explain adjacent to the disabled controls which are unavailable because of connectivity and which depend on age eligibility.

screens.name: Plans — normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows checked yearly selection, clear prices and explicit simulation labels, but the settled capture crops the decorative orb beneath the fixed header.
findings: Use a deliberate compact heading instead of leaving a partial orb visible beneath the header.

screens.name: Plans — large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 stacks enlarged pricing and keeps the primary simulation action visible, with simulated purchase and restore reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Verify that reading packs and any remaining plan information stay reachable below the enlarged primary action.

screens.name: You — empty memory, settings and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 13 and 15 show a clear empty-memory explanation and labeled preferences, supported by reported persistence and keyboard activation checks.
findings: Consolidate the two plan entry points or distinguish their destinations more clearly.

screens.name: Settings — large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows enlarged labels and a visibly enabled large-text switch, while supplied evidence reports 342×52px preference targets.
findings: Verify that native text enlargement preserves label associations and access to lower settings beyond this scrolled capture.

screens.name: Settings — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a conspicuous full-row focus outline, with label, Space and Enter activation explicitly reported as checked.
findings: Extend equivalent focus visibility and verified keyboard behavior to every interactive row and modal action.

screens.name: Share — preview, destinations and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a framed preview and export choices, while supplied runtime evidence establishes PNG export and injected export-error recovery only.
findings: Distinguish verified export actions from friend-link or delivery options whose configured backend behavior remains unverified.

screens.name: Story — export preview and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show a coherent portrait card and export button, supported by reported real 1080×1920 PNG output and export-error recovery.
findings: Provide accessible text equivalent to the exported card and verify OS delivery on a physical device.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The gold orb consistently anchors the screens, and supplied runtime evidence reports animation performance and stopped canvas draws under reduced motion.
findings: Verify a clear accessible name when the orb is actionable and exclusion from reading order when decorative.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Sheets 05–15 show labeled destinations and underline-plus-color selection, with a raised central Ask orb and reported added scroll clearance.
findings: Verify every tab's touch bounds and selected-state announcement, particularly around the raised Ask control.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently pair a restrained title with daily allowance, and the supplied captures show both one and zero remaining.
findings: Verify that allowance changes are announced without repeatedly interrupting the reading flow.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream-filled buttons provide consistent emphasis and visible enabled/disabled differentiation, with several submission paths exercised in supplied browser evidence.
findings: Verify press, busy and disabled semantics consistently across every primary action.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text and divider rows distinguish secondary actions, but the screenshots do not establish their touch bounds or press feedback.
findings: Use explicit destination labels and verify 44pt targets for compact actions such as Change, Retry and Cancel.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show generously separated borderless answer rows, while supplied interaction facts report immediate advancement.
findings: Preserve a clearly selected answer on return and verify focus moves to the next question after activation.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–04 show persistent labels and strong gold field boundaries, with typed-text preservation supported by supplied browser checks.
findings: Distinguish the focus ring from the default field outline so active editing is visually unmistakable.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 03 and 05 show readable multiline enlargement, while keyboard-constrained behavior is supported only by synthetic viewport testing.
findings: Verify caret visibility, long-answer scrolling and submission with native text enlargement and a physical phone keyboard.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 13 shows positional and color state changes plus full-row focus, with target size, keyboard activation and persistence reported as verified.
findings: Verify switch names and on/off announcements with VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 08 separates the free omen from the main Ask flow and shows explicit unavailability alongside a labeled synthetic layout variant.
findings: Offer an appropriate retry route when omen failure is transient rather than making tomorrow the only stated recovery.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 14 links a checked Love star to a labeled sample question and explicitly discloses offline content.
findings: Verify full-size targets around each small star and programmatic selection announcements.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 presents sharing limits and offline recovery without card clutter, and supplied evidence confirms disabled creation.
findings: Associate each disabled control with its specific connectivity or eligibility explanation.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 06–07 consistently distinguish date, question, prediction and status, with saved-history persistence reported in the browser drive.
findings: Make the row's opening action and the meaning of Waiting explicit in its accessible label.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 09 shows checkmarked yearly selection, billing cadence and stacked enlarged pricing, with simulated purchase and restore evidence.
findings: Verify radio-style selection semantics and announcements of the full billed amount.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 13–15 show consistent portrait artwork and uncertainty labeling, although the small preview makes its fine print difficult to inspect.
findings: Make a larger preview or equivalent readable text available before export.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, voice and offline screens expose concrete alternatives, while supplied runtime evidence reports connection and injected export-error recovery.
findings: Verify notices are announced promptly and appear near the controls needed to recover.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: The sheets consistently separate serif reading content from sans-serif utility text, supported by reported enlarged-layout and sampled contrast checks.
findings: Improve small utility-label readability and preserve text contrast during fade entrances.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold gradients support borderless content, with sampled rendered contrast, browser frame timing and reduced-motion checks reported.
findings: Extend contrast verification to translucent text frames and representative native rendering.

limitations: All grades are provisional: assessment uses the attached sheets and supplied runtime summary, without independently executing checks or inspecting underlying evidence files.
Scores describe visible design and reported browser behavior; missing evidence lowers confidence rather than becoming an inapplicable dimension.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, native haptics, real payments and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Transition pairs support composition review but cannot independently establish timing, focus continuity or freedom from distracting movement.
The contrast evidence excludes clipped and partly opaque text, so it does not resolve the visibly dim reveal and check-in transition text.
Synthetic predictions, omen wording and labeled fixture explanations establish layout coverage only; they establish neither production-copy defects nor predictive quality.
Configured social backend behavior is unavailable; disclosed sample stars and disabled circles do not demonstrate working social interactions.
Successful listening, populated memory editing, selected outcome confirmation and several recovery results lack screenshots here, despite some reported browser coverage.
No hard-gate failure is conclusively established by these materials; partially visible scroll content is not proof of an unreachable control.
The authorized A >=9 and F >=9 threshold is not met; no screen or component qualifies for 9/10 certification under the stated physical and assistive-technology boundary.
topFixes: Keep reveal and check-in text readable throughout transitions, including partly opaque frames excluded from current contrast checks.
Expose the complete Sky primary action on entry and eliminate the unintentionally cropped orb in the settled Plans composition.
Verify screen-reader focus, selection announcements and recovery notices across automatic advancement, expanded explanations and outcome recording.
Complete physical-device checks for large text, keyboard safe areas, small secondary targets and OS export delivery.
Clarify Change, Waiting and disabled-control reasons, and place voice failure guidance beside its recovery actions.
Separate verified export capabilities from social sharing destinations whose backend behavior remains unverified.
